method: Gaussian blur of reviewed boxes only: each visible face (eyes, nose and mouth, sigma 0.25 x the box's shorter side) and each identifying text (company and project names, person names and signatures, phone numbers, addresses, watermarks; sigma 0.3 x); every person detected at confidence >= 0.5 has a face box or a recorded reason it shows no face; residual detail <= 0.1 of the original (or a Laplacian variance <= 5.0) in every box, overlapping boxes merged; pixels outside unchanged; then scaled to at most 2048 px and re-encoded without metadata
